entities.name: PMID:27492540
observations: EGEA follow-up in 607 women: self-reported bleach use 4–7 days/week versus non-use associated with non-allergic asthma (adjusted OR 3.3, 95% CI 1.5–7.1) and non-allergic adult-onset asthma (4.9, 2.0–11.6); no association observed for allergic asthma. Adjustment covariates unavailable in abstract.

entities.name: PMID:32829252
observations: Asthma-E3N study of 12,758 elderly women assessed combined irritant products (bleach, ammonia, solvents, acids); use 4–7 days/week associated with non-allergic asthma (adjusted OR 1.27, 95% CI 1.02–1.57), adjusted for age, smoking, BMI; exposure not bleach-specific.
